battle.name: 秦淮河之戰
battle.brief: 開寶八年正月十七日，宋軍在金陵城東秦淮河口強行渡河，擊潰南唐背城而列的水陸十餘萬大軍，再破其溯流奪采石浮橋之師；李漢瓊以蘆葦實艦作火船，順風攻破水寨。南唐十餘萬兵馬盡喪，此役直接引出十月皖口之戰與十一月城破。卡面那件斯巴達長矛從未東來，決定勝負的仍是舟楫、浮梁與火船。

kit.name: 斯巴達長矛
kit.history: 兩米長的木槍，槍尾帶銅套。方陣裡它比劍更早決定誰站得住。

countries: 交戰兩方是北宋與南唐。北宋方面：開寶七年（974）冬，朝廷以曹彬為江南行營都部署、潘美為副都部署，發禁軍主力渡江，西路自池州順江而下，東路自京口溯流而南，另以王明屯獨樹口巡江，樊若水以浮橋之功被擢侍御史、充嚮導。行營之中，步軍都指揮使劉遇、馬軍都指揮使李漢瓊、左廂戰棹都監田欽祚各領所部作戰，全軍糧秣靠江上船運，舟楫就是補給線。南唐方面：國主李煜都金陵，以陳喬、張洎掌謀，樞密使皇甫繼勳總神衛軍，兵分屯湖口、皖口、采石與金陵外圍水寨；開寶七年十二月，李煜下令金陵戒嚴，罷開寶之號，公私記籍改稱甲戌歲，又益募民為兵，許民以財穀獻者論官爵，兵源遂由將門部曲與軍士轉為募兵、民兵混編，裝備與紀律都較徵發之時鬆懈。開戰前三個月，南唐連折大將：十一月曹彬於采石破其二萬餘眾，擒馬步軍副部署楊收、兵馬都監孫震；正月田欽祚於溧水破江南兵，都統李雄謂諸子吾必死於國難，父子八人皆沒於陣。宿將既折，各路守將與新募之兵遂成骨幹。兩相比較：北宋是行營統一指揮、奏報直達朝廷；南唐則將領各守一地而不相統一，李煜深居後苑，軍書告急常被擱置。
countriesEn: The two parties in this battle were the Northern Song and Southern Tang. On the Song side: in the winter of the seventh year of Kaibao (974) the court appointed Cao Bin commander in chief of the Jiangnan field army and Pan Mei his deputy, and sent the main body of the imperial guards across the river, the western route coming down the stream from Chizhou and the eastern route coming up from Jingkou, while Wang Ming was posted at Dushukou to patrol the river, and Fan Ruoshui, promoted to censor for his part in the floating bridge, served as guide. Inside the field army the infantry commander in chief Liu Yu, the cavalry commander in chief Li Hanqiong and the left section naval director Tian Qinzuo each led a detachment of their own, and the grain for the whole army came up the river by boat, the boats being the supply line. On the Southern Tang side: the ruler Li Yu held Nanjing, with Chen Qiao and Zhang Ji in charge of counsel and the director of palace service Huangfu Jihuan commanding the Divine Guard, while troops were posted at Lukou, Wankou, Caishi and in the water camps outside the city; in the twelfth month of the seventh year of Kaibao Li Yu put Nanjing under martial law, abolished the Kaibao era name so that official and private records alike should be dated only by the cyclical year, calling that year Jiaxu, and he enlisted the people anew as soldiers, promising office and rank to whoever gave money and grain, so that the manpower of the army became a mixture of recruited men and militia, with equipment and discipline both looser than when the troops were levied by the proper channels. In the three months before the fighting opened, Southern Tang lost senior commanders in quick succession: in the eleventh month Cao Bin at Caishi defeated more than twenty thousand of their men and took the deputy director of horse and foot Yang Shou and the director of arms Sun Zhen prisoner; in the first month Tian Qinzuo defeated the Jiangnan troops at Lishui, where the commander in chief Li Xiong told his sons that he would surely die in the national calamity, and father and eight sons were all killed on the field. With the old commanders gone, the various provincial garrisons and the newly recruited men became the backbone. Set side by side: the Song fought under a single field command whose reports went straight to the throne, while Southern Tang's generals each held a separate place and did not combine, and Li Yu sat deep in his inner palace with urgent military reports routinely put aside.
people: 此役的關鍵人物分屬兩營。北宋行營都部署曹彬是全軍主帥：采石、池州、溧水一路推進皆出其籌畫，到秦淮河一役，他判定在「舟楫未具」的情況下也必須果斷渡河，不肯給南唐喘息重整之機。副都部署潘美是此役直接下刀的人——所部先濟，擊潰南唐水陸十餘萬大軍，又在江南兵溯流欲奪采石浮梁時旋擊破之，保住宋軍唯一的陸路命脈。馬軍都指揮使李漢瓊負責最險的一著：率所部渡淮南，取巨艦，實以蘆葦，順風縱火，攻其水寨，拔之。開寶三年上書論江南可取、開寶七年獻浮橋之策的樊若水，是這場戰役的前提條件；宋軍能在采石架起浮梁渡江，正是他以小船載絲繩南北牽度江面寬狹的結果，事後以功擢侍御史。開寶八年五月被李煜下獄處死、軍士爭食其肉的皇甫繼勳，是南唐的敗因之一：他身負重兵卻只求速降，不敢言戰，又鞭打部曲而禁其夜出邀戰，全軍為之側目。勸李煜堅壁以待的陳喬、張洎，與宿將李雄、楊收、孫震的相繼折損，說明南唐並非無謀無將，而是謀不見用、將不勝兵。十月率湖口十萬眾入援的朱全贇，則在本役之後的皖口被風火反噬而死，直接斷了金陵最後一援。
peopleEn: The key figures belong to the two camps. Cao Bin, commander in chief of the Jiangnan field army, was the overall commander: the advance through Caishi, Chizhou and Lishui was all his planning, and at the Qinhuai he judged that even in the state of the boats not yet being ready the river had to be crossed at once, and he would not allow Southern Tang the respite to reorganise. His deputy Pan Mei was the man who actually cut at this battle: his troops crossed first and broke the Southern Tang army of more than a hundred thousand by water and land, and when the Jiangnan men came up the river to seize the floating bridge at Caishi he broke them at once, preserving the only land route the Song army had. Li Hanqiong, commander in chief of the cavalry, was given the most dangerous part: he led his men across the river to the south, took great ships, filled them with reeds, set them burning downwind and attacked the water camp, taking it. Fan Ruoshui, who had memorialised in the third year of Kaibao that Jiangnan could be taken and had offered the plan of the floating bridge in the seventh year, was the precondition of the whole battle; the Song army was able to cross at Caishi only because he had run a small boat with a silk cord attached north and south to measure the width of the river, and afterwards he was promoted to censor for his merit. Huangfu Jihuan, whom Li Yu imprisoned and put to death in the fifth month of Kaibao, and whom the soldiers fought over and ate, was one of the causes of Southern Tang's defeat: he held the command of many men yet strove only for a quick surrender, would not speak of battle, and whipped his subordinates and kept them from sallying out at night to challenge the enemy, so that the whole army was turned against him. Chen Qiao and Zhang Ji, who urged Li Yu to hold fast and wear the Song army out, together with the successive loss of the old commanders Li Xiong, Yang Shou and Sun Zhen, show that Southern Tang was not short of plans and not short of generals so much as that its plans went unheard and its generals could not win a battle. Zhu Quanyun, who led one hundred thousand men from Lukou to relieve the capital, was killed by the reversed fire at Wankou in the months after this battle, and that removed the last relief for Nanjing.
kits: 卡面這件斯巴達長矛（dory）約公元前八〇〇年見於希臘，兩米長的木槍，槍尾帶銅套：銅套一是配重，二是可以在盾牆後把槍尾撐地借力，三是萬一斷裂仍可作短矛使用。它必須和方陣裏的盾牌、手甲一起用，單手持槍的人插不進密集的重步兵方陣，孤身一人扛著長矛在平地上也毫無意義——這是希臘重步兵編制的基本前提。秦淮河畔沒有這種方陣，長矛也不會從希臘走到江寧：中國自有另一套長兵器系統，春秋戰國的戈與矛、秦代陵墓陶俑手執的長矛與弩機、漢以後的環首刀與長矛各行其是，兵器形制與戰術配套都自成一格，不曾受希臘影響。宋軍步兵的骨幹兵器是槍，即木杆長矛：輕、長、可挺刺，後來《武經總要》記槍有十七式，長短不一，多以竹木為杆。功能位置上，槍與dory同屬「列陣中把身體與盾牆之間的距離固定下來、抵住對方第一波衝撞」的兵器，只是宋槍沒有銅套槍尾，力量全靠槍纂與漆木杆接合。真正決定秦淮河之役的不是長矛，而是舟楫、浮梁與火：宋軍渡河靠的是船，缺口就落在「舟楫未具」四字上補；南唐反攻是為了拆毀采石浮梁，那是用木竹紮成的浮橋，也是宋軍補給與退路的唯一樞紐；李漢瓊的火船取巨艦實以蘆葦，順風縱火，燒的是水寨裏密集的舟船。此外還有弓弩、刀戟、拒馬與火矢，以及攻城用的雲梯、撞竿、砲與築在城外的水寨長圍。
kitsEn: The weapon on this card, the Spartan dory, appears in Greece about 800 BC: a wooden spear two metres long with a bronze butt spike. The bronze served three purposes: as ballast, as a means of bracing the butt on the ground behind the shield wall to drive the body forward, and as a short spear in its own right should the shaft break. It had to be used together with the shields and greaves of the phalanx; a man who carried the spear in one hand could not fit into the dense hoplite formation, and a single man with a long spear in the open field meant nothing, and that is the basic premise of the Greek heavy infantry system. There was no such phalanx beside the Qinhuai, and the dory never walked as far as Jiangning: China had its own system of long weapons, the ge and the mao of the Spring and Autumn and Warring States, the long spears and crossbow triggers carried by the terracotta figures of the Qin tombs, and the ring pommel swords and long spears of the Han and after, each keeping its own form and tactical pairing, and never touched by Greek influence. The backbone weapon of the Song infantry was the qiang, the wooden shafted long spear: light, long, made to thrust, and the later Military Manual records seventeen forms of it, of differing lengths and mostly bamboo or wood shafted. In functional terms the qiang and the dory belong to the same place, the weapon that fixes the distance between the body and the shield wall in a formation and takes the weight of the enemy's first charge; only the Song spear had no bronze butt spike, its strength coming from the collar and the lacquered shaft. What actually decided the battle on the Qinhuai was not the long spear but the boats, the floating bridge and fire: the Song crossed on boats, and the gap had to be filled in the four characters the boats not yet being ready; the Southern Tang counter stroke was meant to tear down the floating bridge at Caishi, a bridge of wood and bamboo that was the single hinge of the Song supply and retreat; and Li Hanqiong's fire ships were great hulls stuffed with reeds, burned downwind against the packed boats of the water camp. Along with these there were bows and crossbows, blades and halberds, caltrops and fire arrows, and for the siege the scaling ladders, the battering ram, the trebuchet, and the long stockade of the water camps raised outside the city.
tactics: 此役宋軍的打法是三段式。第一段是強渡：史載初涉秦淮，時值舟楫未具，潘美不待舟船齊備便率所部先濟，大軍隨之，而南唐水陸十餘萬背城而陣——南唐把主力倚著金陵城與秦淮水寨排開，陣腳穩固但退路只有一條，士氣繫於城牆，一旦正面被突破便無處可收。渡河能不能成，全看第一批人上去之後能不能站住。第二段是反制：南唐不甘心，遣兵溯流而上，要奪采石浮梁，把宋軍切回江北；潘美旋擊破之。第三段是火攻：李漢瓊取巨艦實以蘆葦，順風縱火直攻水寨，拔之。三步的共同原理是不打散你的隊形而是一起打散：宋軍先在渡口製造崩潰，再保住南唐唯一的反擊手段——奪橋，最後用火去燒南唐最密集的部分。火順風則火船直衝營寨，火逆風則自焚，這一點在半年後的皖口被反轉過一次：朱全贇以火油縱燒宋軍，風忽轉北，反焰回燒南唐本軍，十萬眾不戰自潰。與卡面那件長矛對照，道理是通的：斯巴達方陣靠盾牆與長矛維持密集，密集是力量也是弱點；南唐背城而列的水陸大軍同樣是密集的陣列，火船就是穿透這種密集的東西。秦淮是穿城而過的內河，河道不寬，渡河所需舟楫本不難為，難在江北大軍與渡船之間的銜接太慢——所以史官才記下舟楫未具四字，這四字就是整場戰役的勝負手。
tacticsEn: The Song method at this battle worked in three movements. The first was the forced crossing: the record says that on first touching the Qinhuai, with the boats not yet in readiness, Pan Mei did not wait for the shipping to be assembled but took his own men across first and the main body followed, while Southern Tang had more than a hundred thousand men by water and land drawn up with their backs to the city. The Southern Tang deployed its main strength along the city wall and the water camps on the Qinhuai, a formation with a solid footing but only one line of retreat, its morale tied to the walls, so that once the front was broken there was nowhere to recover to. Whether the crossing could hold depended entirely on whether the first men ashore could stand. The second movement was the counter stroke: unwilling to accept it, Southern Tang sent men up the river to seize the floating bridge at Caishi and cut the Song army back to the north bank, and Pan Mei broke them at once. The third was the fire attack: Li Hanqiong took great ships, filled them with reeds, set them burning downwind and drove them into the water camp, taking it. The common principle of the three steps was to strike the enemy formation as a whole rather than to break it up piecemeal: the Song first created a rout at the landing, then destroyed Southern Tang's only counter stroke, the seizure of the bridge, and finally used fire on the densest part of the enemy. Fire downwind drives the ships straight into the camp, fire upwind burns oneself, and this point was reversed half a year later at Wankou, where Zhu Quanyun used burning oil against the Song and the wind suddenly turned north, so that the flames burned back on the Southern Tang army and a hundred thousand men broke without a battle. Compared with the spear on the card, the principle is the same: the Spartan phalanx kept its density with the shield wall and the long spear, and density was both strength and weakness; the Southern Tang army drawn up with its back to the city was a dense array too, and the fire ships were the thing that pierced that density. The Qinhuai is an inner river running through the city and wide enough to be navigated, so the real difficulty in crossing was never the water but the slow linkage between the army on the north bank and the boats, which is why the annal wrote down the four characters the boats not yet being ready, and those four characters are the whole of the battle.
data: 留下數字的只有《續資治通鑑·宋紀八》數條。日期：開寶八年正月十七日宋軍初涉秦淮，次日出效，水寨拔去，戰役以宋軍全勝收束。兵力：南唐水陸十餘萬、背城而陣，這是史書對南唐大軍的概數，實際到陣的步騎當以十萬量級計；北宋投入金陵方向的具體人數史無明文，只知行營之下有步軍都指揮使劉遇、馬軍都指揮使李漢瓊、左廂戰棹都監田欽祚各領一部。前此三個月，開寶七年十一月曹彬於采石破南唐二萬餘眾，生擒馬步軍副部署楊收、兵馬都監孫震等，獲戰馬三百餘匹；開寶八年正月田欽祚於溧水破江南兵，都統李雄父子八人皆沒於陣。以後的數字可以對照：十月皖口，朱全贇擁十萬眾而號十五萬，縛木為筏長百餘丈，戰艦大者容千人，其自乘大航高十餘重、上建大將旗幡；此役宋軍擒戰棹都虞候王暉等，獲兵仗數萬，朱全贇赴火死。十一月乙未金陵城破，李煜奉表納降，開寶九年正月入京。圍城自正月算起歷時約十個月，與城下累月之語相合。人物年表亦可核：樊若水生於九四三年，卒於九九四年，開寶三年上書江南可取，開寶七年拜太子右贊善大夫，以浮橋之功擢侍御史；皇甫繼勳於開寶八年五月被李煜下獄處死。地理方面，采石在金陵上游、距金陵數日水程，秦淮河自城西入、城東出，是可以舟行的內河，兩岸與河心洲渚是水寨佈置之地。以上數字皆出上述史文，除概數外不宜再作推算。
dataEn: The only figures that survive are a few entries in the Sequel to the Comprehensive Mirror for Aid to Government, Book Eight of the Song Annals. Dates: on the seventeenth day of the first month of the eighth year of Kaibao the Song army first crossed the Qinhuai, the effect showed itself the next day, the water camp was taken, and the battle closed with a complete Song victory. Strength: Southern Tang had more than a hundred thousand men by water and land drawn up with their backs to the city, the annalist's round number for a Southern Tang army, so the foot and horse actually in the line were of the order of a hundred thousand; the number the Song committed in the direction of Nanjing is nowhere stated, and all that is known is that under the field army the infantry commander in chief Liu Yu, the cavalry commander in chief Li Hanqiong and the left section naval director Tian Qinzuo each led a part. In the three months before, in the eleventh month of the seventh year of Kaibao Cao Bin at Caishi defeated more than twenty thousand Southern Tang men and took the deputy director of horse and foot Yang Shou, the director of arms Sun Zhen and others prisoner, and captured more than three hundred warhorses; in the first month of the eighth year Tian Qinzuo broke the Jiangnan troops at Lishui, where the commander in chief Li Xiong and his eight sons were all killed. The later figures make a useful comparison: in the tenth month, at Wankou, Zhu Quanyun had one hundred thousand men, called one hundred and fifty thousand, bound wood into rafts a hundred and more zhang long, with warships able to hold a thousand men, and his own great vessel more than ten decks high with the general's banners flying; the Song took the naval director Wang Hui and others prisoner, captured tens of thousands of weapons, and Zhu Quanyun ran into the fire and died. On the day yiwei of the eleventh month the city of Nanjing was breached and Li Yu presented his table of surrender, entering the capital in the first month of the ninth year of Kaibao. The investment of the city lasted about ten months counting from the first month, in agreement with the saying that the city stood under the walls for months on end. The chronology of persons can be checked as well: Fan Ruoshui was born in 943 and died in 994, memorialised in the third year of Kaibao that Jiangnan could be taken, appointed Right Companion of the Crown Prince in the seventh year, and promoted to censor for the floating bridge; Huangfu Jihuan was imprisoned and put to death by Li Yu in the fifth month of the eighth year of Kaibao. Geographically, Caishi lies upstream of Nanjing, a few days by water away, and the Qinhuai enters the city from the west and leaves it on the east, an inner river that can be navigated, with the banks and the sandbanks in the river the places where a water camp could be set up. All these numbers come from the passages cited above; beyond the round numbers no further calculation should be attempted.
cause: 打起上來的根由有兩層。宏觀一層是北宋的統一次序：後蜀已平（九六五年）、南漢已平（九七一年），剩下能據江表、當天下財賦、扼長江下游的只剩南唐；不取南唐，南北分立就一天不會結束，而宋廷的戰略正是避開兩面作戰、先取南後取北。南唐扼著三處要衝：采石、皖口、湖口，三處各築水寨與浮梁式的江防，扼住北軍南下的路。直接促成此役的是浮梁：樊若水開寶三年上書論江南可取，開寶七年宋軍取池州、採其浮橋之策，在采石架起浮梁，北軍從此不必仰賴舟船便可過江。浮梁一立，采石的守備就失去了意義，南唐只剩下金陵城東秦淮河這一道門戶必須守住，於是十餘萬兵背城而陣——這一局非勝不可，因為無路可退。南唐內部的處境同樣是敗因：宿將在兩三個月內相繼折盡，皇甫繼勳持重兵而務求速降、不以死戰自任，陳喬、張洎勸其堅壁以老宋師而李煜不預軍政，改元罷開寶之號與大募民兵恰恰說明朝廷對局勢失去了把握。攻守雙方的條件在開寶八年正月同時到位：一邊有可渡江的浮梁與不肯緩手的行營，一邊有倚城而列、士氣與將略都不足以支撐的十餘萬大軍。
causeEn: There were two levels to the coming of the fighting. At the higher level lay the order of Song unification: Later Shu had been taken in 965 and Southern Han in 971, and the only state left that held the regions south of the Yangtze, commanded the richest revenue in the empire and held the lower course of the great river was Southern Tang; until Southern Tang was taken the division between north and south would not end, and the Song strategy was precisely to avoid fighting on two fronts, taking the south before the north. Southern Tang held three key positions, Caishi, Wankou and Lukou, each with a water camp and a barrier of the floating bridge kind, and they closed the road by which a northern army could move south. What immediately brought on this battle was the floating bridge: Fan Ruoshui had memorialised in the third year of Kaibao that Jiangnan could be taken, and in the seventh year the Song took Chizhou and adopted his plan, raising a floating bridge at Caishi, so that the northern army no longer had to depend on boats to cross. Once the bridge stood, the defence of Caishi lost its meaning, and Southern Tang had only the Qinhuai at the east of Nanjing left to hold, so more than a hundred thousand men were drawn up with their backs to the city, and this battle had to be won, for there was no line of retreat. The internal condition of Southern Tang was a cause as well: the old commanders had been destroyed within two or three months, Huangfu Jihuan held the command of many men yet strove for a quick surrender and would not take responsibility for fighting to the death, Chen Qiao and Zhang Ji urged that the Song army be held at bay and worn out, and Li Yu did not attend to military affairs, while abolishing the Kaibao era name and enlisting the people by the thousand showed that the court had lost its grip on the situation. The conditions on both sides came together in the first month of the eighth year of Kaibao: on one side a field army with a bridge to cross the river and a determination not to let up, on the other a hundred thousand men relying on the walls, with neither morale nor generalship enough to hold them.
impact: 秦淮河之役是南唐崩塌的樞紐。此戰之後，南唐在金陵周圍喪失十餘萬兵馬與整套水寨，都城周邊的防禦力量幾乎為零；李煜不得不急召周邊守將入援都城，這一急召直接催生了十月發生的皖口之戰，而皖口朱全贇之死又抽掉了金陵最後一支外援，十一月乙未城破只是時間問題。宏觀上，五代十國的分裂局面至此基本終結：宋得江南財賦與長江天險，統一大業只剩下北漢一個目標，一九七九年下太原便告完成。此役在技術與制度上都留了痕。技術上，浮梁渡江開了無船亦能過大江的先例，樊若水其人後來被文天祥過采石時的詩句不上蛾眉二十歲、重來為墮山河淚、還有古人曾有樊若水點名；火的使用也從此變得講究風向，朱全贇以火油縱燒而反被北風回燒，是十世紀水戰裡記錄得最清楚的一次風火逆轉。制度上，宋廷平江南後分置諸路、換置官屬、收兵權歸禁軍，江南的賦稅與鹽利從此供養了對北漢的最後一役。文化的副產物則更長久：李煜降宋後所作的詞，春花秋月何時了、往事知多少與四十三年如一夢，成為亡國之音的代表，開了詞寫身世的一條新路。至於卡面那件斯巴達長矛，它與此役仍然無關：它連東亞的門都沒有進過，而這場戰爭真正被記錄下來的，是浮梁、火船與水寨。
impactEn: The battle on the Qinhuai was the hinge of Southern Tang's collapse. After it, Southern Tang lost more than a hundred thousand men and its whole system of water camps about Nanjing, and the defensive strength around the capital was very nearly nil; Li Yu was compelled to summon urgently the commanders of the outlying garrisons to the capital, and that urgent summons directly produced the battle of Wankou in the tenth month, while the death of Zhu Quanyun at Wankou removed the last relief for Nanjing, so that the breach of the city in the eleventh month on the day yiwei was only a matter of time. At the larger scale, the division of the Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms was now essentially at an end: the Song had gained the revenue of Jiangnan and the natural barrier of the great river, and of the unification only Northern Han remained, taken at Taiyuan in 979. The battle left traces in technique and in institutions as well. In technique, the bridge of floating timber opened the precedent of crossing the great river without boats, and the man responsible was named by Wen Tianxiang in his poem on passing Caishi, with its lines about returning twenty years after Mount Emei to shed tears for the rivers and hills, and the ancients had Fan Ruoshui. The use of fire also came to pay attention to the wind, and Zhu Quanyun's burning oil reversed by a north wind is the clearest recorded reversal of wind and fire in a tenth century water battle. In institutions, after the pacification of the south the Song divided the region into circuits, changed the officials, and gathered the military power into the imperial guards, and the taxes and salt revenues of Jiangnan from that time on paid for the last campaign against Northern Han. The by product in culture lasted longer: the poems Li Yu wrote after his surrender, the spring flowers and autumn moon and how many memories of the past, and forty three years were like a dream, became the emblem of the song of a ruined state and opened a new road in which the lyric could carry a life. As for the Spartan dory on the card, it is still irrelevant to this battle: it never even entered East Asia, whereas what this battle actually put on record was the floating bridge, the fire ships and the water camps.
result: 結果是宋軍全勝、南唐全敗。秦淮河口一戰，南唐背城而列的水陸十餘萬大軍被強行渡河擊潰，溯流奪采石浮橋之師旋敗，水寨為火船所焚而拔，浮梁完好，宋軍自此穩坐江南岸；南唐十餘萬兵馬一朝散盡，金陵外圍再無一兵可用。宋軍隨即合圍金陵，李煜召湖口兵入援，十月皖口之役朱全贇焚死、援軍盡喪；十一月乙未城破，曹彬整軍成列至其宮城，李煜奉表納降，開寶九年正月入京，被封違命侯，數年後改封隴西公，三年後卒於汴京，宋人稱他為李後主。南唐至此覆亡，北宋統一南方大局定。這場戰爭的勝負判定很清楚：決定它的是舟楫是否齊備、浮梁是否守得住、火順風還是逆風，以及有沒有人敢在舟楫未具時先渡河，而不是任何一件單兵兵器。卡面那件斯巴達長矛在這裏只留下一個對照：斯巴達以盾牆與長矛維持密集方陣，密集既是力量也是弱點；南唐以背城的水寨與船隊維持另一種密集，而火船正是穿透這種密集的東西。兩者相隔一千七百餘年、一萬數千里，用的兵器從未互換，但隊形這一課講的是同一件事。
resultEn: The result was a complete Song victory and a complete Southern Tang defeat. In the action at the mouth of the Qinhuai the Southern Tang army of more than a hundred thousand by water and land, drawn up with its back to the city, was broken by a forced crossing; the force that came up the river to seize the floating bridge at Caishi was broken in turn; the water camp was burned by the fire ships and taken; the bridge stood; and the Song army sat securely on the southern bank. More than a hundred thousand Southern Tang men were scattered in a single day and not one soldier remained outside Nanjing for the defence of the city. The Song then closed in, Li Yu summoned the army of Lukou to relieve him, and in the tenth month at Wankou Zhu Quanyun burned to death and the relief was destroyed; on the day yiwei of the eleventh month the city was breached, Cao Bin drew his troops up in order before the palace, and Li Yu presented his table of surrender; in the first month of the ninth year of Kaibao he entered the capital and was made Prince of Violating Orders, was later given the title Duke of Longxi, and died at Bianjing three years afterwards, the Song calling him Li the Later Lord. Southern Tang was thus extinguished and the Song unification of the south was settled. The verdict on this battle is plain: what decided it was whether the shipping was ready, whether the floating bridge could be held, whether the wind blew downwind or upwind, and whether anyone dared to cross first with the boats not yet in readiness, and not any single soldier's weapon. The Spartan dory on the card leaves only a comparison: the Spartans held their dense phalanx with the shield wall and the long spear, and the density was both strength and weakness; the Southern Tang held a different kind of density with its water camps and its fleet drawn up behind the city, and the fire ships were exactly the thing that pierced that density. The two are more than seventeen hundred years and some ten thousand li apart, and their weapons were never exchanged, but the lesson of the formation is one and the same.
